2607.22375.title: IDEAgent: Agentic Quality-Diversity Search for Research Idea Generation
2607.22375.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have significantly automated the process of scientific discovery over the past few years. However, existing systems share one core limitation: they generate and optimize ideas independently for either Quality or Diversity. This often leads to the generation of ideas in close proximity to one another or to a large set of trivial, unsound, or unclear concepts. In this work, we instead argue that research ideation should be treated as a conjunction of both objectives and framed as a Quality-Diversity (QD) search. In line with this perspective, we introduce IDEAgent, a multi-agent framework that manages the evolution of ideas through lineages. We jointly drive Quality using multi-objective feedback for dedicated repair and refinement, while Diversity is achieved through lightweight sequential memory and explicit comparison against completed ideas, their historical ancestors, and rejected proposals. To systematically evaluate this QD conjunction, we develop Yield, a joint metric that computes the largest set of mutually diverse ideas that satisfy a predetermined quality threshold. Finally, through evaluations across 32 topics spanning 8 domains of Computer Science, we show that IDEAgent outperforms the best baseline by 3.89x on Yield, while achieving non-zero Yield on 8x more topics. We further corroborate these findings through an analysis of quality improvements, showing that repair and refinement are crucial for building logical rigor and clarity while preserving non-obviousness. To encourage future research on QD-search-based ideation, we open-source IDEAgent at https://github.com/declare-lab/IDEAgent.
2607.22375.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在過去幾年中顯著自動化了科學發現的過程。<lb/>然而，現有系統存在一個核心限制：它們獨立生成和優化想法，專注於質量或多樣性。<lb/>這通常導致生成的想法彼此之間相距甚近，或產生大量瑣碎、不合理或不清晰的概念。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們主張研究構思應該被視為兩個目標的結合，並框定為質量-多樣性（QD）搜索。<lb/>根據這一觀點，我們引入了IDEAgent，一個通過血統管理思想演變的多代理框架。<lb/>我們通過多目標反饋共同推動質量，進行專門的修復和精煉，而多樣性則通過輕量級的序列記憶和對已完成想法、其歷史祖先及被拒絕提案的明確比較來實現。<lb/>為了系統性地評估這一QD結合，我們開發了Yield，一個計算滿足預定質量閾值的最大相互多樣化想法集的聯合指標。<lb/>最後，通過在涵蓋8個計算機科學領域的32個主題上的評估，我們顯示IDEAgent在Yield上比最佳基線高出3.89倍，同時在8倍更多的主題上實現了非零Yield。<lb/>我們進一步通過質量改進分析來證實這些發現，顯示修復和精煉對於建立邏輯嚴謹性和清晰性至關重要，同時保持非顯而易見性。<lb/>為了鼓勵未來基於QD搜索的構思研究，我們在https://github.com/declare-lab/IDEAgent上開源了IDEAgent。
